title: Article 134 Article 134  A juridical act subject to a condition precedent is void if the condition is dependent only upon the intention of the obligor.
statute_text:
Article 134 Article 134  A juridical act subject to a condition precedent is void if the condition is dependent only upon the intention of the obligor.
(Effect of Arrival of Assigned Time)

rules.supporting_span: A juridical act subject to a condition precedent is void if the condition is dependent only upon the intention of the obligor.
rules.explanation: A juridical act is considered void if it contains a condition that depends solely on the intent of the person performing the action.
